newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-BERGEN REJECT EVERTON BID FOR TWO PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BERGEN REJECT EVERTON BID FOR TWO PLAYERS.

text.p: Norwegian premier division club Brann Bergen said on Wednesday they had rejected a 2.5 million pound ($4 million) bid by Everton for midfielder Claus Eftevaag and striker Tore Andre Flo.
"We have turned down an initial bid of 2.5 million pounds for both players," Brann chairman Lars Henrik Berge said. "Everton will not make another offer so the negotiations are over."
Norwegian newspapers say Flo, who has played 11 matches for the national team, is worth almost four million pounds alone on the English market.
Brann were knocked out of the European Cup Winners' Cup last week by Liverpool.
